name: Beer Taxonomy Pixel Icon Atlas

coordinateConvention.rectangle: x/y origin with positive w/h extents; right and bottom are exclusive
coordinateConvention.gridIndices: row and column are 1-based; index is 0-based

notes: The two source sheets were measured at 1254x1254 pixels.
Because 1254 is not divisible by nine, cell boundaries use round(i * 1254 / 9). Frames are therefore 139 or 140 pixels wide and high.
Use the frame rectangle supplied for each sprite; do not calculate a fixed cell size.
The generated artwork is concept-quality pixel art. Inspect critical icons at runtime scale before treating the images as final production assets.
